body: Large language models fine-tuned from a shared base can be merged by averaging their task vectors, but some merges collapse far below the base model, and common merge operators give no warning before evaluation. We show that one statistic of the specialists' task vectors both predicts this collapse and calibrates its repair. The power that averaging removes equals the variance of the task vectors across specialists, our measure of interference. Under a working noise model, the disturbance that a merge injects grows with the merge coefficient and with interference, yielding a pre-merge score. In our experiments on twenty-two merge configurations from four model families, only destructive merges exceed a threshold on this score. We find that statistics of sign conflict between specialists, a common target of existing merge operators, are anti-predictive. We then predicted the outcomes of fourteen merges before evaluating them, and twelve predictions were correct, including the destructive outcome of a specialist pair pushed past the threshold by continued pretraining. To address this collapse, we introduce PRISM, an operator that averages the task vectors first and then soft-thresholds each layer at a level set by the layer's interference. Without data or tuning, PRISM keeps all five destructive merges above the threshold within evaluation noise of the base model, where plain averaging falls at least 14.4 points below it or collapses entirely. We apply PRISM only above the threshold and keep the plain average for merges below it, which include all fifteen harmless ones. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/PRISM.
summaryZh: 大模型合并（Model Merging）常因任务向量间的干扰导致性能崩溃。研究发现，任务向量的方差是预测合并崩溃的关键统计量。基于此，作者提出了PRISM算法，通过在合并后对各层进行软阈值处理，有效抑制了干扰。实验证明，PRISM在无需额外数据或微调的情况下，能使破坏性合并保持在基准模型性能范围内，解决了传统平均法无法预警且易导致模型失效的问题，为模型集成提供了稳健的解决方案。

glossary.explanationZh: 模型合并，指将多个微调后的模型参数进行融合以获得多能力模型的技术。
任务向量，表示模型微调前后权重差异的向量，用于描述模型在特定任务上的改变。
软阈值处理，一种数学操作，用于在合并过程中过滤掉干扰较大的权重分量。
干扰，指不同任务向量在合并时产生的负面相互作用。
